cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Interesting. The picnic moved from Saturday to Friday. Whose blue pen is that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. And whose handwriting adds hearts to Fridays?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Now, who should tell the Saturday guests?
